scientific_integrity: Analytical derivation of one-step eigenvalue, mean-square covariance-operator spectral radius, and global affine cost-budget phase diagram. The independent audit was not performed, and finite verifier runs do not establish universal assertions.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic consistent real two-equation systems, i.i.d. static joint masks, abstract work costs 0/1/1/w with w>2, and allowed idle draws. No guarantee for wall-clock runtime, nonempty-only samplers, multidimensional full systems, adaptive masks, inconsistent data, or finite precision. The abstract of the October 2026 companion paper was read but its full text could not be obtained for decisive comparison.
title: Sharp work-budget phase transition between one-step and asymptotic randomized two-row Kaczmarz
